issues.issue: Exhibit F prints one 'Taxes' line. The split uses the General column of Exhibit D (p4), which prints exactly these two lines for the same fund, and they add up to 4,093,699, so it is defensible. But the rule only allows a split when the report breaks down that line itself, and State/Local on the same schedule were left as broad groups. Also, budget_final is null on both split items even though 4,081,265 is printed, and the original_label values ('Taxes (property tax portion)'...) are not printed labels.
The disbursement rules list noxious weed control under natural resources/conservation. The report prints it under Public Works, and the extractor already marked it for review.

In Exhibit D (p4), the Road column breaks this line down as Miscellaneous 32,373 (53%), Charges for Services 28,645 and Intergovernmental 295. Under the 'more than half' rule the dominant category is miscellaneous/other, not charges for services.

In Exhibit D (p4), the General column breaks this down as charges 499,345 (46%), interest 491,444 (45%), misc 21,039 and intergovernmental 71,589. No category is more than half, and charges only barely beat investment income. Defensible as the dominant category, and it is already marked for review.
Schedule 4 (pp11-13) shows that most of this is Horse Arena 352,288 and Fair 287,091 (73% together). 'fair/event revenue' may fit better.

issues.on_page: Schedule 2 has 3 columns: Special Revenue Funds (Schedule 4), Jail Bond, Nursing Home Bond, plus Total
issues.issue: The rule is to record per fund for up to 6 fund columns. Schedule 2 has only 3, but one of them is a 14-fund special revenue total (Schedule 4), so the extractor's use of the Total column is defensible. The two debt service funds are not separated.
